beats.headline: Out of the burning substation
beats.text: Subject is a level ten human and a non-combatant, filed as a Human Resources Associate for the line. She comes running out of the burning substation at Trainyard E in one heel with a ghoul at her hair, rides the Nightmare Express as far as station sixty, where the employees are supposed to live, finds nothing there, and sits down to wait for Rod. Her name was probably something like Jennifer or Ruth before she had it changed, around the time of the divorce.

beats.headline: The gold armband
beats.text: Subject describes the Kravyad as a human resources initiative: blue, six-armed, and paid in one or two dwarves a shift. They hypnotize the crews stepping off the trains and hold them until the next shift is due, so nobody remembers a break and nobody asks for time off. Productivity up thirty-five percent. Workers who ask anyway get a trip to her office and a gold armband, and are told it will send them home. It tells the Kravyad they are safe to eat. That was her idea. It added five percent in Q2. Even Rod was impressed.

beats.headline: Hanged by the staff
beats.text: Subject Madison, human resources associate, is dead. The dwarves and gremlins of the Tangle built a stand and a noose and hanged her, once word spread, as Fire Brandy tells it. Fire Brandy did not see it. They brought the body to her, and she took it into the fire. Carl's assessment: Madison did not deserve it, though her character did. That is the whole difficulty with a staff that is starting to notice it is a cast.
